주인은 자신을 속였다며 화를 냈어요. 그러고는 긴 머리카락을 잘라 버리고, 라푼젤을 먼 들판으로 데려갔지요. 바람이 부는 낯선 길에 선 라푼젤은 천천히 숨을 골랐어요.
en: One day, the guardian found the silk cord beside the window. Rapunzel decided that she would no longer hide what was in her heart.
“I have made a friend. And now I want to see the world outside.”
The guardian grew angry and accused her of hiding a secret. She cut off the long braid and took Rapunzel far away, to a lonely meadow. On that unfamiliar path, Rapunzel took a slow, steady breath.

ko: 라푼젤과 왕자는 서로를 아끼며 함께 살기로 했어요. 먼저 숲 가장자리의 작은 집을 찾아, 오래전 헤어진 부모님을 만났지요. 어머니와 아버지는 자란 딸을 품에 꼭 안았어요.
“이제 내일은, 내가 사랑하는 사람들과 함께 열어 갈 거예요.”
새집에는 문이 활짝 열려 있었고, 창가에는 푸른 채소가 자랐어요. 라푼젤의 노래는 더는 높은 탑에 머물지 않았어요. 그 노래는 열린 창문을 지나, 넓은 세상으로 멀리 퍼져 나갔답니다.
en: Rapunzel and the prince chose to build a life together. First, they found the little house beside the forest and the parents she had lost long ago. Her mother and father held their grown daughter close.
“From now on, I will welcome tomorrow with the people I love.”

Their new home had an open door and green leaves growing beside its windows. Rapunzel's song no longer belonged to a lonely tower. It drifted through the open window and far out into the wide, welcoming world.
